rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is rarely seen, found, or encountered.

example.english: This kind of deep-sea fish is uncommon at wet markets.
example.traditional: 呢種深海魚喺街市好少見。
example.jyutping: nei1 zung2 sam1 hoi2 jyu2 hai2 gaai1 si5 hou2 siu2 gin3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that something is exceptional or remarkable rather than merely rare.

example.english: Their performance this time was uncommon and impressed even the coach.
example.traditional: 佢今次嘅表現非同尋常，連教練都讚不絕口。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 ci3 ge3 biu2 jin6 fei1 tung4 cam4 soeng4 lin4 gaau3 lin6 dou1 zaan3 bat1 zyut6 hau2
